conjecture: Q77 (Seed Q3; MO 406152 'Naive Schur-Weyl duality for the 0-Hecke algebra'): for the 0-Hecke algebra H_N(0) acting on V^{(x)N}, dim V=n (q->0 Jimbo action), with A=image of H_N(0), S=End_H(V^{(x)N})=S_0(n,N) (owned: Deng-Yang JPAA 216 (2012) Rem 2.5 via Jung-Oh 2509.26194 (4.7)), does the reverse centraliser B=End_S(V^{(x)N}) equal A? Answer: NO in general; first failure (n,N)=(2,5).

tree.approach: Classify (n,N) with A=B; explain the n=2 failure.

children.approach: DC fails at (n,N)=(2,5): dim A=42 (=Cat 5), dim B=43, dim S=56=C(8,5). dc.py (mod p=1000003, weight-block reduction) and fullV_Q.py (exact over Q, full tensor space, both conventions I: pi_i sort-up idempotent, II: Jung-Oh sign T^2=-T) agree.
Abar=H/Ann for n=2 is NOT kC_N (Catalan monoid) despite dim Cat(N): Abar has F_{N+1} simples (3,5,8,13 for N=3..6) vs 2^{N-1}. V ~= (N+1)P_empty + sum_j P_{j} as H-module (N=3..7).

V is projective-injective (H Frobenius, V proj) and faithful over Abar, so A=B <=> exists 0->Abar->M0->M1 with Mi in add V (Morita-Tachikawa/codominant dim w.r.t. V >=2). Equivalence to domdim Abar>=2 only if add V contains all proj-inj Abar-modules (unchecked).
